title: Measure of a biased random function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $p\in[0,1]$. The measure associated with the product probability law on Boolean-valued functions on $\{-1,1\}^n$, with independent values each true with probability $p$, equals the product measure whose coordinate laws are the corresponding single-bit probability law.
